title: Task store v2 still refuses with "another process holds the task store lock"
body: Parallel chat work can still fail with “another process holds the task store lock” after the move to one file per task. Inspect task admission and owner/store locking in `crates/coder/src/task/`, including `Store::open_for_owner`. Make short-lived contention wait briefly instead of refusing an otherwise valid start, and keep unrelated tasks independent. Preserve exclusive execution for one task: a command must not run while another owner holds that task's lock. Add regression coverage for contention and independent starts. Keep changes within the locking/admission behavior; do not change record formats, task cleanup, or engine execution policy.
